chapter_guide.mission: Bring meaningful conversations to communities around the world, through podcasts, live talks, events and local storytelling.
chapter_guide.vision: A global network of local chapters. Don’t just attend inspiring talks. Create the platform that makes them possible.
chapter_guide.network: AntiSocial Talks is building a global network of local chapters that bring meaningful conversations to communities around the world, through podcasts, live talks, events and local storytelling.
chapter_guide.framework: Every chapter runs its own programme inside the global brand and chapter standards. The global team provides the framework, brand guidance, speaker standards and onboarding. Training, support and any financial terms are written into the official chapter programme.

chapter_guide.talent_sources: Universities and research. Startups and founders. Community groups and nonprofits. Arts and creative communities. Professional and scientific networks. The wider community, by personal recommendation.
chapter_guide.speaker_qualities: A clear idea, honest communication, willingness to prepare, fit for the audience. Judged on the contribution, not on fame.

about_values.title: Better questions
about_values.body: We look for the question that makes a guest stop and think before they answer.

about_values.title: No easy outs
about_values.body: We keep the awkward parts of the conversation that most interviews edit out.

about_values.title: Everyone has a voice
about_values.body: Founders, scientists, artists and athletes, alongside people who have never been interviewed before. What matters is having something to say.

about_values.title: Anti-silence
about_values.body: We are not against society. We are against keeping quiet about the things that matter.

community_ways.title: Share Your Story
community_ways.blurb: Something happened that you’ve never talked about publicly.
community_ways.heading: Tell us what happened
community_ways.accent: and why it stayed with you.
community_ways.lede: Some of our best conversations come from people who have never been interviewed before. If you have a story like that, tell us here.
community_ways.message_placeholder: What happened, and why does it still matter to you?

community_ways.title: Submit a Question
community_ways.blurb: A question you’d like us to put to a guest.
community_ways.heading: Ask the question
community_ways.lede: If we use your question with a guest, we’ll credit you on the episode.
community_ways.message_placeholder: What would you ask, and who would you ask it of?

community_ways.title: Suggest a Speaker
community_ways.blurb: Someone you think we should interview.
community_ways.heading: Point us at someone
community_ways.lede: They don’t need to be famous. Tell us who they are and why you think people should hear from them.
community_ways.message_placeholder: Their name, what they do, and what makes their thinking worth an hour.
